text_block_list.text:
One day after training,
Special Week came over, saying she wanted
Maruzensky to teach her how to cook.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, Spe-chan!
I'm happy to see you, but what's this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Actually, just a moment ago, Tazuna-san showed me a photo of the dish Maruzen-san cooked!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"It looked sooooo incredibly delicious,
I just couldn't get it out of my head...!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to be able to cook
wonderful dishes like that too~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so?
You really love eating, Spe-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, leave it to me!
I'll whip Spe-chan right into shape!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, without further ado,
what kind of dish should we make?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "A hearty, delicious soup you can whip up quickly even on a busy morning, huh...?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: A delicious, slow-cooked stew that takes plenty of time to make, huh!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, what should I do?!
I just can't decide~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Then how about we let Trainer-kun decide?
If it turns out delicious, I'll treat you to some♪
choice_data_list: A hearty, loaded soup you can whip up in no time!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Then how about we let Trainer-chan decide?
If it turns out delicious, I'll treat you to some♪
choice_data_list: A hearty, loaded soup you can whip up in no time!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Loud and clear~! In that case,
let's practice making it in five minutes♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: F-Five minutes?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uwooh, I'll do my best!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: —Let's put the bouillon and water in the pot, and while it comes to a boil, chop up all the other ingredients!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A-All of them!?
Carrots, onions, enoki mushrooms, AND celery!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "It'll boil in about two and a half minutes, so let's move quickly~!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hyeeeeh~~!

――Before long, a colorful and vibrant
vegetable soup was ready!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, under 5 minutes and totally groovy!
You worked so hard, Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yay! I did it~! Smells so good!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, I wonder if
I've gotten just a little closer to being like Maruzen-san♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks Spe-chan.
I feel like my skills have really improved too♪
The quick soup Maruzensky taught me to make was packed with veggies and totally delicious!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Loud and clear! In that case,
let's take a nice, slow five hours
to make a stew!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
F-Five hours?!
Whoaa~!! I'll do my best!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Nice and slow, simmer it gently over low heat.
Be sure to skim off the scum as it rises~."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...So slooow... and steaaady...
Somehow, it's making me hungry.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, patience, patience!
You must never rush a good stew!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, smells so good!
Isn't it almost ready!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, perfect timing. Parboiling is done♪
Now to switch pots, add water and seasonings—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Put on the drop-lid and let it simmer for another two hours~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Two hours!?
My tummy's already at its limit!"

――Before long, the rich, flavorful,
tender stew was complete!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, smells so good~!!
I wanna eat it right now, right this second~!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to be honest, I was at my limit too.
Let's dig in mammoth-style right away♪
The stew recipe Maruzensky shared was gently seasoned and absolutely delicious!
